_about: Layout and behavior of the shared Config screen (scripts/ui/config_screen.gd). Sizes are internal pixels (384x216). The screen lays itself out inside whatever size it is given, so the title screen shows it full size and the field menu can embed it in its side window. Strings are in data/text/config.json.

controls._note: Each row is one button the player can remap: a keyboard key and a controller button. 'actions' are the InputMap actions it drives. swap_sets lists groups that must stay different from each other: binding one to a button another in its set holds swaps them. Clutch is left out of the sets on purpose (it shares buttons with Confirm and Jump).

tap_along._note: Metronome test. Beats are interval_s apart after lead_in_s. The first ignore_first matched taps are dropped, taps further than outlier_ms from the middle value are thrown away, and at least min_taps must be left. bias_ms is taken off the average (leave 0 unless playtests show people tap early). The ding is the battle's own ding.
